documentation.content:
The /health uptime check is failing from more than one region, which means the API cannot answer at all -- as distinct from answering wrongly, which the sustained-5xx policy covers.

This is the shape the v2.0.8 boot failure took: Flyway failed, the revision never passed readiness, and no 5xx was ever recorded.

Runbook: docs/engineering/operations/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md#api-unreachable

conditions.displayName: uptime check failing from 2 or more regions
